title: Paper-cuts for Spring Festival
subtitle: 考点：装饰房间 / cover / decorate
passage: Spring Festival is coming. Lin Hua's family is cleaning and decorating their home. This year, Lin Hua wants to make some paper-cuts for the windows.

She needs red paper, scissors and glue. First, she folds the paper in half. Then she draws a picture of a fish on it and cuts along the lines. When she opens the paper, there are two fish side by side. The fish is a popular pattern at Spring Festival because it stands for a good life.

Lin Hua makes ten paper-cuts and puts them on the windows with glue. Her grandmother covers the table with a red cloth and puts fresh flowers on it. In the evening, the whole family sits together in the warm living room. The smell of freshly made dumplings fills the apartment, and everyone feels full of joy.
